financials.key_metric: Strong CEE presence. Attempted Commerzbank acquisition.

overall_strategy_summary: [PLACEHOLDER] UniCredit is a leading European bank with strong positions in Italy, Germany, Austria, and Central/Eastern Europe. Under CEO Andrea Orcel, the firm has delivered record profitability and attempted to acquire Commerzbank. Digital asset activity limited to European experiments and Eurosystem CBDC participation. Broader strategy: operational efficiency, capital returns, geographic optimisation, digital banking transformation, and potential M&A.
